review: W Faust is an ID that has great clashes and excellent debuffs. She also has stats that makes her pretty good at tanking attacks. The only downsides she may have is that her damage is bad and her speed is quite low, but her speed being low may be really good due to the fact that she can do one sided attacks and inflict insanely good debuffs or use any ego that helps the entire team by the time the turn ends. There's one case where slow speed can be good and this is that one case. Notable E.G.O Synergies: Fluid Sac - The only time where being one of the slowest IDs in the game has a benefit. Due to W Faust being among the slowest, she is most of the time guaranteed to use Fluid Sac at the end of the chain, meaning everything gets healed HP and SP after they are done with their actions.
